trap.label: passiva biográfica
trap.wrong: She was borned in London and taught by tutors; her notes are study today.
trap.right: She was born in London and taught by tutors; her notes are studied today.
trap.why: Em português “nasceu” é ativo; o brasileiro fabrica borned. Em inglês, was born (irregular) e passivas exigem particípio (studied).

rewrite.prompt: Passe para a passiva: “Tutors taught her.”
Passe para a passiva (presente): “People study her notes.”
